name: neutral_metacommunity
description: Hubbell (2001) zero-sum neutral metacommunity: independent fixed-J islands over an area gradient, each evolving by Moran dispersal-drift from a shared species pool. Richness and the species-abundance distribution emerge with no niche differences and no colonization/extinction rate asymmetry — the neutral counterpoint to MacArthur-Wilson.

density.description: Individuals per unit area (sets local size J = area*density)

immigration_base.description: Per-replacement immigration probability m at distance 0

distance_min.description: Least isolated island distance (linear across islands)

distance_max.description: Most isolated island distance (0 = isolation held fixed)

seed.description: RNG seed; each island uses seed + its index

island_00.doc:
One island under Hubbell's (2001) zero-sum neutral metacommunity.

A fixed-size ``J = max(1, round(area * density))`` local community evolves by
``J`` Moran death/replacement events per generation (see module docstring).
Species are ecologically equivalent; richness and the species-abundance
distribution emerge from dispersal-drift balance, not from niche or rate
differences.

Inputs
------
abundance : map[string, float]
    Current per-species counts on this island (read from the shared store;
    seeded with ``J`` immigrants by the composite builder). Sums to ``J``.

Outputs (deltas, so the stores accumulate to absolute values)
-------
abundance : map[string, float]
    Net per-species count change over this generation's ``J`` events.
richness : float
    Local richness delta (species present now minus the previously recorded
    count), emitted against the previous reading so the ``float`` store
    telescopes to the current number of species present.

_contract.description: type(name, bases, dict, **kwds) -> a new type

emitter.doc:
Store historical states in memory.

``subsample`` records only every Nth composite tick (default 1 =
every tick). Use this for long runs or composites with heavy
state (large fields, many agents) to keep RAM bounded — the
saved time-series still reflects the simulation's true cadence
via each row's ``global_time`` field.

``max_len`` optionally bounds ``history`` to the most recent N
recorded rows (a ring buffer): once the cap is reached each new
record drops the oldest. Default ``None`` = unbounded (the
historical behaviour — consumers such as v2ecoli that read the
full ``history`` are unaffected unless they opt in). ``max_len``
counts *recorded* rows (i.e. post-``subsample``).

_contract.description: type(name, bases, dict, **kwds) -> a new type
